title: Tree iterator predecessor
summary: Recover the 0x4235a0 thiscall member operation: replace sentinel with its right link, descend to the maximum of a left subtree, or climb parents. Return the iterator address and write only its node pointer. Original disassembly and stack-iterator callers confirm layout and ABI.
test_description: Direct i386 thiscall oracle comparisons for all insertion permutations of binary search trees of sizes zero through seven, with sentinel bytes 1, 128 and 255. Check every node and end iterator, expected predecessor, returned this pointer, iterator canaries, and bytewise unchanged node links, color, padding and payload. Includes empty, singleton, minimum-to-sentinel, left-subtree descent and repeated parent climbs.
known_limits: Null pointers and cyclic malformed trees are outside the valid linked-tree contract and are not tested.
Color meaning, payload types and owning tree operations are not recovered.
The 32-bit original node offsets require 32-bit pointers; native wider-pointer ports use the corresponding native struct layout.
No byte-matching claim is made. No OS, allocation or exception dependencies occur in this routine.
